verdict.rationale: v0 lets users push/export generated code to GitHub repositories (open, standard format) and import/export via its SDK/API, giving a real 'leave' path for code artifacts. However there's no evidence of exporting other data (chat history, project metadata, design tokens) in open formats — only code/GitHub is covered. Missing for 10: documented export of chat history/project metadata, explicit 'export all data' feature, and independent confirmation of a full data-portability workflow.
